from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """One court document from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the court document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The legal nature of the case, e.g. 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative'")
    charges_or_causes: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific criminal charges or civil causes of action identified in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
